title: Lawn & Planting Care
text: Aftercare: Freshly laid turf and new planting require daily watering by the client following installation. Petrie Landscapes LTD cannot be held responsible for foliage degradation due to lack of watering.

title: Payment Milestones (25% / 50% / 25%)
text: Payment Terms: 25% deposit required upon order confirmation, 50% progress payment due midway through works, and 25% final balance due upon completion.

title: Payment Milestones (30% / 60% / 10%)
text: Payment Terms: 30% deposit required upon booking to secure start date, 60% stage payment due on delivery of materials, and 10% final balance due upon completion.

title: Quote Expiry Date (30 Days)
text: Quote Expiry: This quotation is valid for 30 days from the date of issue. Prices may be subject to review thereafter due to material cost fluctuations.

title: Site Access & Utilities
text: Site Access: Client to provide clear, uninterrupted access to the working area, as well as access to working electricity and a mains water supply throughout project duration.

title: Standard Ground Conditions
text: Price based on normal ground conditions. Any unforeseen underground services, drainage issues, or unexpected concrete/rock excavation will be discussed prior to execution.

title: Work Duration and Start Date
text: We estimate the work will take 3 weeks weather permitting.Our speculasated start date is 25th December 2027
